description: ANN ARBOR, MI - Washtenaw County Commissioner Jason Morgan, D-Ann Arbor, announced his bid for state House, according to a campaign release Thursday.He seeks to replace Rep. Yousef Rabhi, D-Ann Arbor, for the 53rd District seat, since Rabhi is term-limited.Morgan, a county commissioner for District 8 and the chairman of the board from 2019-21, touted his progressive roots and political experience in the county as reasons to run.“This year has been a challenge for almost everybody,” Morgan said i
